head: 1430d42
summary: Final confirmation on 1430d42. Since w22b (5e5e561) only 04_shaders.js and 12_scene.js changed (git diff --stat: plus review md files), and no monument geometry, material or atlas code. Measured old vs new, share of pixels changed by more than 8 L: q11, q19, m03, m06, m09 and m12 0.00 %; m05 0.32 %; q13 1.22 %; m02 1.69 %; q01 2.56 %. Every changed block is window-belt light: the cabin windows seen past the bar cheek in m05 (90-148,243-373), the left windows in m02, the PY window belt in q13, and the door-1 lining lit by the door window in q01 (168-379,247-340, L210 -> 200, still neutral at B/R 1.00). The door-3 bar, welcome galley, F front wall, lavs, door-4 group and rear galley are pixel-identical or within noise, so the lighting run regressed nothing. Rated afresh, geometry first, against omaat_j32 (re-downloaded): the bar's face layout, proportions and element order match the in-service unit with no structural mismatch. The ovens read L137 against the photo's ~140, cabinet mean L48 against L59, and the counter in m05 p50 24 against p50 24 in the photo. The remaining differences are all low and were already listed: the flat white nosing (L216 uniform; the photo has a satin rail with p10 10 / p90 180), the cabinet reading as an open shelf unit, the flat bright control panel, the right bay crushed to L3, and the black soffit where the photo has a lit pale ceiling. I score 8.8, 0.1 under my w22b 8.9. Nothing regressed; side by side with j32 the white nosing and the dark soffit read a little more than I credited last round, and the weaker sub-areas (lavs 8.0, the bulkheads and rear 8.4) hold the area mean down. There are no high or medium issues.
lighting_note: Not scored. The lighting run 4 changes touch the monuments only where window-belt light falls on them: the door-1 lining near the door window drops about 10 L (q01 L210 -> 200, still neutral, not a regression), and the window glimpses past the bar cheek in m05 go about 5 L darker and slightly cooler (B/R 1.04 -> 1.07). As before: the bar's right open bay renders L3 against L12 in j32 (crushed recess or AO), the counter has no local reflections (j32 mirrors the ovens and monitor), the q11 lower ash doors read p50 177 against j32 p50 139 (that photo has warm, dim exposure; trafficnews is about L161), and the ceiling directly over the bar renders as a black soffit where j32 shows a pale lit panel.

calibration.issue: Integration L13 MEDIUM: bar follows the 2019 render rather than the in-service face
calibration.evidence: q11 and m05 have 0.00 % / 0.32 % changed pixels against w22b; the m05 change sits only in the window glimpse at x 90-148. q11 upper face (190-555,140-345) p10/50/90 11/55/182 (w22b 11/54/180; j32 10/53/165). Element order against omaat_j32 is unchanged and correct.

calibration.issue: w22b MEDIUM (B, w22 candidate): ink print figure/ground inverted
calibration.evidence: The ink walls fall in m02 and q01 regions with no change; m02's change is confined to x<126 (left windows). The w21 print stands.

calibration.issue: w19b MEDIUM: F front drapes warm brown
calibration.evidence: In m02 the drapes (440-550,100-560) are outside the changed region; they render as charcoal-navy.

calibration.issue: w22b low: glass cabinet reads as open shelving
calibration.evidence: m05 cabinet (655-780,180-400) p10/50/90 37/42/67, unchanged. The shelf rails and boxes are still crisp and the stiles thin. j32 cabinet (760-900,200-680) 32/62/84 is a smoked field with a wide dark stile.

calibration.issue: w22b low: nosing is a flat white band
calibration.evidence: m05 nosing (100-700,500-512) p10/50/90 215/216/235. The j32 rail band (0-600,580-640) p10/50/90 10/44/180: a satin-aluminium rail with a highlight line and a dark underside.

calibration.issue: w22b low: simplified oven fronts / flat control panel (A)
calibration.evidence: m05 control panel (175-300,145-200) p10-p90 136-143, uniform. In j32 it is a dark recessed switch field with lamps. The ovens have no round dish and no top grille strip.

calibration.issue: w22b low: right open bay crushed to black
w22b low: canopy and cheeks over the bar
calibration.evidence: m05 and q11 still show a black soffit with 3 downlights, and ash cheeks. j32 shows a pale lit ceiling panel over the unit and a dark-grey carcass side face.

calibration.issue: w18-w21 carried lows (welcome-pane glass cue, ash grain, plain J lav doors, door-1 dark-wood streaks, F-wall joint hairlines)
calibration.evidence: m03, q11 and q19 are pixel-identical. q01 changed only in the door-1 lining tone.

calibration.issue: Did lighting run 4 regress any monument?
calibration.evidence: The largest monument-surface change is the door-1 lining: q01 (168-379,247-340) L210.1 -> 200.3, B/R 1.001 -> 1.001, with p10 145 -> 141. It is a uniform small dimming with no change in hue or structure. All galley, bar, lav and bulkhead pixels are within 8 L.

issues.issue: Counter nosing is a flat bright-white band; in service it is a rounded satin-aluminium rail
issues.fix: 10_mono.js MONMAT.nosing '#e4e5e6' r0.3 m0.25 -> '#b8babc' r0.28 m0.7; make the front piece a 0.025 m half-round so it gets a highlight and a shadow line.

issues.issue: Glass-door cabinet reads as open shelving, not smoked glass (shared serviceFace, so it shows on the welcome galley too)
issues.evidence: m05 cabinet p10/50/90 37/42/67 with crisp shelf lines; j32 32/62/84, contents barely legible, wide dark stile.
issues.fix: serviceFace: darken the contents and shelves to L<=70 or add a smoked pane (about #2e2c2b, a 0.55), and widen the stiles 0.05 -> 0.07 m.

issues.issue: Control panel is a flat bright plate; oven fronts simplified
issues.evidence: m05 panel p10-p90 136-143. j32 shows a dark recessed switch field with lamps, round dished oven handles and a top grille strip.
issues.fix: serviceFace: inset a dark field 0.32x0.12 m in #3a3835 carrying the lamps and toggles; add a 0.10 m dark ring behind each oven handle.

issues.issue: Black soffit and ash cheeks over the bar; j32 shows a pale lit ceiling panel and dark-grey carcass sides
issues.evidence: m05 top band is near-black with 3 downlights. In j32 the panels over the unit are pale grey-white.
issues.fix: buildBar: cheeks in carcass #3a3835. The soffit is a ceiling/lighting call.

issues.issue: Right open bay crushed to black
issues.fix: Bay lining #2a2826, or a faint warm strip light under the monitor ledge.

issues.evidence: Welcome-pane glass cue, ash grain repeat, plain J lav doors, door-1 dark-wood streaks, F-wall joint hairlines. The renders are unchanged.
